about.meta: Meet the Digital Factory Teams of NIB International Bank, who build digital products that help businesses and institutions transform.
about.title: Banking expertise, built into software that runs your business
about.lead: NIB Digital Solutions is the product arm of NIB International Bank's digital transformation program. We build platforms for the institutions and businesses we serve, and we design every one around real operational problems.
about.missionTitle: Help every organization we serve operate digitally
about.missionText: Schools collecting fees in cash, property managers chasing rent by phone, cooperatives on paper ledgers: these are the problems our products solve. By combining software with NIB's payment infrastructure, we help customers save time, reduce errors and reach their own customers digitally.

automation.title: Automation first
automation.text: We replace manual, paper-based processes with workflows that run themselves, so your teams can focus on customers.

connected.title: Connected by design
connected.text: Every product connects to NIB digital channels for payments, collections and settlement, with APIs for your other systems.

trust.title: Bank-grade trust
trust.text: Built and operated to banking security standards: role-based access, audit trails, encryption and secure hosting.

partnership.title: Partnership, not just software
partnership.text: Implementation, training and support from a local team that understands your market.

about.securityText: This website only collects business contact details to arrange demos and answer inquiries. We never ask for account numbers, PINs, passwords or OTPs.

controls.encryption: Encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
controls.audit: Tamper-evident audit trail on product and lead changes
